notes.title: Patch 237: Over 50 Bug Fixes and Improvements!
notes.content:
🎮 [b]Platform & System Updates[/b]
* Sort saves by the most recent one loaded.  
* Fixed crash when loading corrupted data.  

🚢 [b]Boats & Vehicles[/b]
* Added a spot light to the tub boat’s light so it actually acts as a light source.  
* Boat icon on the map is now darker and purple for better visibility.  
* Fixed holes inside cruise boat (near interior doors).  
* Doors to floating shipwreck cabins should now be destructible.

📦 [b]Inventory & Items[/b]
* Fixed issue allowing items to be placed repeatedly if only one was left in inventory.  
* All bakery items should now be correctly placeable.  
* Bamboo Bookcase variant colors should not revert to the original when picked up.   
* Fixed item placement and collision issues across various maps.  
* Added wonky sauce spawn locations to Wonky Burger Ruins on Carn A Vale.  
* Fixed multiple issues with feet slots and swapped footwear combinations.  
* Fixed some issues with peg legs and other shoes.  
* No longer displaying both shoe slots if there is a shoe alt slot being used  

🍳 [b]Crafting, Cooking & Furnishings[/b]
* Crafting station image now matches the selected station.  
* Loom will now play animation while active.  
* Fixed issues with Solid and Advanced Forges not displaying VFX and SFX correctly.  
* Fixed issue with cooking pot not displaying animation correctly.  
* Added SFX to drinking animation.  
* Fixed crab molding material and farmer/mushroom wallpaper (vertical stripes).  
* Salt can now be used in any recipe that requires salty ingredients.  

🛏️ [b]Characters & Animation[/b]
* Critters will no longer try to align with the player when turning in an item while they are sitting  
* Fixed characters facing the player incorrectly when delivering items from a ride or seated position.  
* Critters should now correctly use other types of benches instead of just the Park Bench  
* Characters will now sit correctly on the Rockinghorse furniture item.  
* Items should no longer be stuck in Critters hands when turning in commissions.  
* Items will be put away correctly during some Fetch quests for Grumpy and Weird personalities.  
* Farmer blouse should no longer occlude the pelvis if worn on its own  
* Increased population cap from 16 to 17 citizens.  

🗺️ [b]World, Terrain & Nodes[/b]
* Made it so a number of resource nodes on Critter Cove will not respawn after being dismantled. May have to dismantle them one last time after they respawn next.  
* Added missing terrain tiles so that certain routes on the map can have more direct sailing.  
* Fixed terrain seams and smoothing around the workshop.  
* Radio Control Tower Quest now tells you the correct otter to turn the Control Panel into.  
* Added more round ceramic planter resource nodes to the world  
* Added more oar resource nodes to the world.  
* Added animation to the fish and cart ride parts when dismantling  
* Removed barber pole spawn.  
* Sourbouys should no longer float above planters when fully grown.  
* Unlocked additional player and NPC house Critter Cove.   

🏘️ [b]Collision & Placement Fixes[/b]
* Fixed issue with shovel use animation when used outside of certain areas.  
* Fixed missing collision around:  
    * Rigg’s Outpost  
    * Sunken city  
    * Sunken houses near Port Bella  
    * Woolington quest rocks  
    * Barn near Port Bella  
* Fixed issue with collision meshes not loading properly at start of new game because of a bug in character creation.  
* Added additional checks to ensure loading of colliders and meshes.  
* Meowise Painting and Mouse Statue should now display correctly in the museum.  
* Fixed light/collision on museum ceiling lamps.  
* Added ceiling lamps to the original museum wing.  

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 [b]NPCs, Dialog & Behavior[/b]
* Sprout will now have something to say when they are on the way to or from the Farmers Market.  
* Added more tourist dialog for when they are moving between tourist attractions.  
* Fixed error where tourists were not talking if doing Baitshop activities  
* Added better behavior for when Critters and Tourists are interacting with deco plants.  
* Tourists using soap boxes should have correct conversations now.  
* Critters should no longer follow the player around if a home visit quest is rejected.  
* Fixed duplicate scenario spawning during storm refreshes.  
* Fixed issue with scenario replacement when already talking to a critter.  
* Copperbottom will no longer offer his personal quest until after the player has completed Renard quest and made the pirate suit.  
* Anchor’s pipe will no longer be sticking through the shutters when the port office is closed.  

🧩 [b]Quest & Scenario Fixes[/b]
* Fixed issue with being able to give character friendship bracelets before they ask for them  
* Added map tracking for Farmers after quest completion.  
* Fixed issue where quest completion state wasn’t saved properly after reload.  
* Critters should no longer invite you over to their house if they are still living in a tent  
* Rum Runner quest should no longer be repeatable. Also any duped quest should now be correctly cleaned up.  
* Updated lookie-loo soup scenario.  

🧪 [b]UI, Icons, and Technical Checks[/b]
* Fixed Credits UI "Back" button missing controller mapping.  
* Small islands will now show up on the maps as a special island icon.  
* Fixed load game UI breaking when deleting characters.  
* Improved picking resolutions in the settings screen.

notes.title: Emergency Patch 228
notes.content:
Fixed bug where save files have been growing over time after finishing the Sprout the farmer part of the Rum Runner Quest.

This caused hourly saves and save exits to be very slow over time as the save continued to grow in size.  When a save is loaded this fix will clean out the bad data on Sprouts inventory and stop the extra inventory item (friendship braclets) from being added again over and over.

Sorry for those that have been affected and big thanks to Justin (FFC) for finding this issue.

notes.title: Uncover The Secrets of Critter Cove in The Enchanted Islands Update - Live Now
notes.content:
[p]Ahoy! We’ve launched the Enchanted Islands Update, our biggest single update of Critter Cove since we entered into Early Access last year and an expansion of the playable area of the game by nearly a third![/p][p]The update features multiple new islands, new quests, the next town rank, and a new museum upgrade. Of course, there are also loads of new customization items, decorations to craft and critters to recruit.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/566e6e5385d04200d22050024631a5b2d80cea68.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Accessing the New Islands[/b][/p][p]If you’ve been with us from the very start and you’re anxious for new stuff to do, some content is available right away; but to really open up what the new islands have to offer, you’ll need to visit your tavern keeper to get the “Rum Running For Ruckus Juice” quest which will get you out and exploring the new biome and characters.  [/p][p][i]If you’re just starting out on The Cove, don’t worry, this new content will blend right in![/i][/p][p]And if you’re still debating whether or not to take the plunge and join us on the island, there’s more great news: we’re 30% off in the Summer Sale starting today![/p][p]More information below... but before you read on, a quick reminder if you haven't already to join us on [url="https://discord.com/invite/QtUafGf"]Discord[/url] and [url="https://bsky.app/profile/crittercove.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url]![/p][p][/p][h2]New Locations[/h2][p]Sail north from town and you’ll find yourself in a mysterious island chain that looks very different from the places you’ve explored so far.[/p][p]These islands are both larger and more mysterious than the islands closer to Critter Cove,  places where relics from the time before are much more visible from between the leaves of exotic flora.[/p][p]And new islands also mean more ocean to sail through, so we’ve also added new caves and a bunch of underwater areas awaiting exploration.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/ed4091d59ead20ba90eeffa53ca28a34d9f03358.png"][/img][/p][h2]New Town Rank[/h2][p]Keeping your tourist upgrades maxed out will allow you to bring a bakery and a gym to Critter Cove, offering both new food to enjoy… and new ways to work it off![/p][p]You’ll need to find townies to take up the roles of Bakery Owner and Gym Manager, and both buildings can help increase your tourist satisfaction too. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/02d864342c198147624d7401b3c8a49622104720.png"][/img][/p][h2]Farmer’s Market[/h2][p]A new market stand you’ll find in the world will sell you brand new furniture items and new seeds for crops. There’s just one small problem – they might not be too eager to accept your doubloons! Perhaps there’s something else you’ll be able to offer in trade?
[/p][h2]Treasure Hunting & Museum Upgrade[/h2][p]Spend some time hunting for resources for the museum and you’ll be able to build a brand new wing, just in time to fill it with all the treasures you’ll find that are scattered not only in the new areas but all around the existing world. [/p][p]Those treasures can take the forms of items, fossils, gold plates, and even … ducks, so don’t forget your shovel, and your new wetsuit!
[/p][h2]New Quests[/h2][p]Dive into some of Copperbottom’s backstory, meet new characters who have made the enchanted biome their home, and learn from long-abandoned ruins how to craft working carnival rides! We’ve added tons of quests, big and small to enjoy as you explore the new biome.[/p][p]We’ve also added plenty of brand new Critters to join your town and some new scenarios to make recruiting them for your adventures more varied.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/62bc38d1068df05140c7f012c2ac8b0eac68c943.png"][/img][/p][h2]Furniture, Crafting and Customization Upgrades[/h2][p]Many crafting machines can now be upgraded to level 3, and with those upgrades, there are also new decoration items, tools and crops to discover. [/p][p]We’ve also been expanding the interior options since our housing update last month, so you’ll be able to create a Country and Bath set to add some class to your surroundings.[/p][p]But what’s the point in exploring if you can’t do it in style? We’ve also added a bunch of new style variants, hairstyles, tails and some new clothing items. And for those of you who’ve been waiting for “Chompy” the robotic dinosaur… he’s there waiting for you to learn how to craft him…
[/p][h2]Plunger Launcher[/h2][p]Lastly, if you’ve been wondering what to do with all those plungers you’ve found during your explorations, this release has the answer.  The one… the only… plunger gun!  No spoilers, you’ll have to find the recipe on your own, but this little baby will allow you to collect treasures that are out of reach without it.
[/p][h2]Been Gone A While?[/h2][p]Haven’t played since launch? Firstly, welcome back! Here’s a few more updates we’ve released since Critter Cove launched into Early Access, big and small:[/p][list][*][p]Robotic Helpers and Barges[/p][/*][*][p]Upgraded decoration UI, control over who lives in your town, and other highly requested Quality of Life improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Tons of new clothing, customisation and decorative items[/p][/*][*][p]Decorating the homes of your Critter friends[/p][/*][*][p]Animation and technical performance upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Gardening Job & New Plants[/p][/*][*][p]Barnacle’s Fishing Quests and Rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Controller Remapping[/p][/*][*][p]Hundreds of bug fixes and tweaks[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Opening Our Doors! Cozy & Family Friendly Games & Housing Update Now Live!
notes.content:
The housing update is here! You can jump in and check that out right now, and we are now less than a month away from our major update; everything’s coming up Sammi!

Plus, if you haven't picked Critter Cove up just yet, now is the perfect time to do so, as we’re joining the amazing games at the [b]Cozy & Family Friendly Games Fest[/b] to celebrate this update – and also because those guys are awesome, of course, so a big thank you to them for including us!

Our discount in the looming summer sale will be the exact same amount, so if you grab it now you are still getting the best discount, but with the added bonus of having time to get through the current stories before the new update.

[h2]Let Me In, I Just Wanna Judge Your Couch[/h2]

In our newest update, Critter Cove has opened up its doors, and characters will now invite you into their homes. Well, if they like you enough, at least… you’ll need a minimum relationship of four hearts to score an invitation to hang out, allowing you to quietly judge everyone’s taste in furniture.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/e0fbad8c035554c967b7ab6dadffbd160c5d8f6a.png[/img]

Each home is uniquely decorated to reflect the personality of its owner, adding a personal touch to the village. We’ll let you ask her why on earth the starting centerpiece in her home is a skeleton, but I suppose we shouldn’t be surprised.

Gifts that you give characters might also show up in their house if they think you’re matching their vibes, which makes things feel a little more permanent and gives you a little more impact over the interiors of Critter Cove. Plus it’s always nice to be appreciated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/9ac929ad99216694a8a4ccf3ef6f0316b9af6ea0.png[/img]

This is provided that the character in question does actually appreciate your gifts of course. Not everyone thinks Hot Air Balloon Wallpaper is the height of style (sorry).

[h2]When Friendship Means Full Renovation Rights[/h2]

When you reach six relationship hearts, a character might even ask you to come in and do some more serious redecorating for them, which will give you full control over their space, managed just like your own home. 

You can make some small improvements, or you can throw everything out and start from scratch, like an episode of Extreme Home Makeover. That’s the strength of a six heart friendship for you!

All items that critters can use outside they can use indoors as well, including the spring horse – health and safety concerns be damned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/a18d037d6f132c28d3b9eec6f3350efa805f1480.gif[/img]

Now that houses are a part of the island, we’ll be adding more quests and of course, more interior decorating options in the future.

[h2]Our HUGE World Update is Launching Mid-June[/h2]

A reminder that we’re launching our biggest update yet on the 24th of June!

Here’s a tease of the new islands – from a spoiler-free distance…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/a96008818e51580212aa9f87b4d746186164146c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/eb9c6fcc924b1e84d09b82fd206ee109ce096d9e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/7953b788bb2aac5207c0bd4985ea81db792d27df.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/d02bcfc529a93bbfbd4e7063e09339b36abe54ea.png[/img]

Not long to wait now, so as always… we’ll see you on the island!

Thanks Dee for discovering and reporting this bug.

notes.content:

notes.title: Bug Fix and Update Preparation Build 292
notes.content:
This build helps us prepare for both the visiting and decorating Critter home update and new islands update both will be coming out very soon.  First the Critter Home decoration update then shortly after will be the new islands update.  Will be putting out a blog post about all this on the 12th of May with the fixed times for both updates.  So a lot of new stuff coming very soon.  Thank you for your support and patience.


[b]Visuals[/b]

We added a visual sign to the outside of houses to indicate who owns the house.


[b]Bug Highlights[/b]

Fixed inventory item loss for FIX IT quests/actions like the Crab Shop, Air Machine, Boat Upgrade Control Panel, etc Quests.   Anytime you "fixed up" a broken object ie crab shop, boat upgrade, upgrade boat panel, air machine and any others like that it would take two items from your inventory not just one.

Fixed issues with critters riding or standing on items like the spring rides or soap box being off center.

Fixed issue where Critters would potentially stay at home for longer then they should after sleeping making it hard to interact with them or find them.  They will now leave their house correctly.

Fixed items like the easel and barbells being placed close to walls could cause the character to go through the wall when used. 

Fixed items that you need to be in specific position to use should now cannot be placed where the space needed to stand to use would go through a wall or object.

Fixed picking up a trunk or anything with storage with an almost full inventory in the decoration mode can results in loss of items if there are more items in the storage then available in player inventory.

Many More.

notes.title: A Feature Update For Our Belated Valentine (That’s You!)
notes.content:
[h2]New Characters & Customization[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/2ff1ac44d68bea8f9788381768327fc1ee966397.png[/img]

Introducing our newest critter family members! Mason the Mothman, Ernie the Duck, Sage the Jackalope, Zeke the Zebra, Jeri the Giraffe and Rosie the Frog.

We’ve also added a new owl head option and new shipwrecked critters (and did some orthodontia for some mammal heads with crooked teeth)!

What other critters would you like us to add in the future? We’re not slowing down, so let us know in the comments or on Discord!

[h2]New Decoration System Mode [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/46d2cf41e87de8bfb6a0a402dd28f2f989856cf2.png[/img]
 
You can now enter the decoration system by pressing P from the main screen in addition to the usual method. Once in this mode, you will remain in decoration mode until pressing Back/Escape, allowing you to grab any placeable items without having to place or adjust your items one at a time.  

Bonus?  This mode now includes moving full chests, carts, planters with crops, etc.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/18c60a9530a0bc71a2de256ef50eaa32a21c2ec4.png[/img]

That’s right.  You will have access to ALL your chests and inventory while in this mode and can continuously place down items without leaving decoration mode.  

This might sound small but we think this is a vast improvement to the current cumbersome system and should dramatically improve not just placing new items but adjusting and rearranging old placements.  

Extra extra bonus? This new system will also allow us to start working on new features like allowing you to expand and customize your interior space.

[h2]New Clothing Options[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/9b53546f0720843950d6e670a8f9cdd25f426490.png[/img]

Looking to upgrade your wardrobe, or even better use new pieces to upgrade the look of your townsfolk?  

We have good news!  Try out the new ancient Egypt line, try your hand at zen gardening in our snappy new kimono, try out our new headgear in the form of two new cowboy hats and a new wrap, or get cozy with the new sleepytime robe or robe and pants combo (and don’t forget the bunny slippers)!

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

Currently, we’re working through our new islands – new quests, new activities, new things to find and new things to find out! 

Sneak peak?  Ok, but just a tiny bit… our next feature islands are called Port Bella and Lonely Pools, but there are of course their surrounding smaller islands to explore as well (and don’t forget the underwater areas).  

Excited?  Believe us, we are too!  

We can’t wait to get you out there sailing around exploring, salvaging and rescuing stranded critters.  To the old guard, who have been with us since the beginning (dare we say even BEFORE the before-times), thank you for staying with us.

[h2]A Thank you![/h2]

To the new players, who are every bit as enthusiastic in their support, thank you for starting this journey and becoming part of our community.  We are at a loss to fully express how grateful we are and how much fun this has been because of all of you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/73046cd025186fd98d66fb09ee1a3a83ef5b2b4e.png[/img]

We hope you had a great Love Day!  Critters will get heart balloons if you have the balloon cart and it’s stocked with balloons. [i]Unlike real partners, they won't mind you're five days late.[/i]

notes.title: Introducing the Boats, Bots and Barnacles Update!
notes.content:
The first of our content updates is now ready to enjoy! We originally planned in our roadmap to have just a few really big updates, but instead we’ve split that into smaller, more frequent updates so we can release exciting content faster and there’s more opportunity for feedback as we go:

As such, you can call this the “Update 0.5” of our original plan, but that doesn’t mean it’s half as good!

Here's a quick peak of what's included:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/51fde2194323aa009b302a0778e83e87c8f45cc6.png[/img]

While you're downloading, here's some more info about what's included...

[h2]Robo Helpers and Barges[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/2359fd25d59c3c973196ef1013a0a892b04a5482.png[/img]

Ever wish you could just tell Copperbottom to go down to the beach and collect all the salvage? Well he’s not going to do that for you, he’s way too busy inspecting your new forge. But we do have the next best thing. Explore new areas and gather recipes to create helper bots that will take over your day-to-day salvaging. Added bonus, finding the parts involves torpedoes and runaway barges. Bonus: this is just the first of our plans for bots and barges!

[h2]Barnacle’s Fishing Quests and Rewards[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/e713d1094ccab5d8e8b959d44e27e72b188447d2.png[/img]

Barnacle is back with some new fishing quests and unique rewards. Word has it that the otters of Boomerang Bay have a bead on our elusive fisherman and will report from time to time on his whereabouts, so keep checking your weather reports!

[h2]Gardening Job and New Plants[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/380c8d1004dda61b623d2ee6ccdfcb22a2edfc45.png[/img]

Gardening is now an official job on Critter Cove! Assign a critter to tend the plants and they will make the rounds each morning to water, all you have to do is harvest. (In case you’re counting, yes, this means you can leave your watering can in your trunk, freeing up a space in your hotbar!) Just be careful, as with any job on The Cove, some critters are better suited to gardening than others.

[h3]Boat Upgrades[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/3af0738c6d4c7ef890e01a4e1dccc35aa9dda8bb.png[/img]

Did we already mention torpedoes? Yes? Ok, it’s just that we’re so excited about them! Catching those pesky barges will also involve upgrading your boat’s speed. So… go faster plus torpedoes?  You’re welcome. As with the bots and barges, the even better news is that this is only the first of our planned boat upgrades!

[h3]Change who Lives in Critter Cove[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/a04d29506a9c38ca59988c3e335231bdf9714b8f.png[/img]

Perhaps the most anticipated change is the ability to modify who lives on Critter Cove. In this update, you can select which critters should move along to make room for new castaways, no hard feelings (although, truth be told, it seems that some of you kind of want to have a showdown with a character or two… but that’s ok).

[h3]And more![/h3]

We’ve also added in much-requested control remapping and have added two new languages: Spanish and German.

Plus there's loads of new clothing items, new house items:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/2005170cb2d45503d1e63710461e668596b2a46c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/813193aefd2e3826a4bd0e88e50b0976934919e5.png[/img]

But wait, there's more! We have new quests and critters to meet, more body customization (you can use a mirror to adjust this any time) and, very importantly, a crab feeding station to keep your crustaceans satisfied.

We nearly named this update the “Boats, Bots, Barnacles and Breakfast (For Crabs) Update” but it didn’t fit in the title box.

As always your feedback is why we’re here in Early Access so we’d love to hear how you and Barnacle get on! You can join us and share your prize catches over on [url=https://discord.com/invite/QtUafGf]Discord[/url], too.

We’ll have more details to share in December about our next major content patch, which will expand the world with multiple new islands and put those boat upgrades through their paces.

notes.title: What We’ve Been Up To...
notes.content:
Hey Critters!

It’s been just over a month since we launched the game into Early Access, and we’ve been really blown away by the response. 

You’ve all been just super fantastic in your support, and we look forward to your continued support as we move forward in making Critter Cove an even better game. So thank you, thank you, thank you.

[h2]What We’ve Been Up To[/h2]

Since launch day, we’ve been prioritizing and sorting issues and suggestions based on your feedback. We’ve been focused on fixing up bugs with over 100 bug fixes across more than ten updates. We’ve also added some quality of life improvements, and a few new bits of content here and there. 

Of course there’s always more to do… Even though we want to really get back to working on the main game more, we will continue to release regular bugs and QoL improvement patches until we get the game into its best possible state.

The biggest change that we are going to make moving forward is we are going to split the Roadmap into smaller chunks instead of trying to do them in just two large pushes. By splitting them into smaller sections, we can get content updates out quicker. 

This first content patch will include automated resource gathering Robots, new boat upgrades, farming improvements, including an NPC Gardener job, the ability to move townies out, a whole lot of new quests, and a bunch, bunch more.

German and Spanish language support is also continuing rapidly, and we’ll keep you updated.

 We can’t wait for you to get your hands on what we’ve been working on.

[h2]An Upgraded Demo[/h2]

We’ve also found a little bit of time to add many of our recent improvements and fixes to the demo.

Alongside hundreds of fixes and improvements, there’s some major performance upgrades that we had made between releasing the demo and the Early Access build that are now included, and much more complete language translations. 

If you have friends that you think might enjoy the game, now is a great time to point them towards that!

We look forward to continuing to make Critter Cove an even better game, and thank you again for being such awesome fans.

notes.title: IMPORTANT PATCH FIX - Storm Resource Refresh Not Always Working
notes.content:
Finally tracked down the bug that many of you have run into where a storm refresh of resources, including refreshing critters to pickup out in the world, did not appear to always happen or appeared to have some very long waits between storms (weeks).

The issues was you could sleep through a storm, so sleeping right away on a storm day in the morning or anytime before the storm hit would not count as a storm day and the resource refresh would not apply.  So technically you could keep sleeping over and over and never have a storm refresh.

You will now get credit for the storm refresh when you wake up on the day after the storm if you slept through the storm on the previous day.  Sorry for the delay in tracking this down and thank you to everyone who reported the issue.

notes.title: The Critter Cove Early Access Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey Critters!

We're launching into Early Access in less than 24 hours, so we thought now would be a great time to share with you all what we'll be working on during our Early Access period, along with some common questions about tomorrow. 

We're going in with a strong plan and have two big updates already in the works that we can share the info for right away!

[h3]The Roadmap[/h3]

Tomorrow... we launch! Here's a full list of the upcoming features you'll be able to enjoy from tomorrow, including over 300 bug fixes and QoL improvements from the demo:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/2435ce9bcbc4097e35b01e6ed26cc49fc41e0c1a.png[/img]
After launch, we'll start work on our first major update, which will include an expansion to the world of Critter Cove that will increase its size by ANOTHER third, along with some more major questlines and adding the bakery and gym to the village.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/4cff6acf8aaadb7b47545acbf4691681a296993d.png[/img]
Our second major update will include more ways to manage tourists, even more world locations and an expansion to the town including the salon, clinic and school. You'll be able to create your own Critters that will appear in the world, and we'll be adding seasonal events and birthdays for even more variety:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/3a16abb3db06a6f19898329e29f027eb6d60eb0f.png[/img]
These plans are of course subject to change. We might move some stuff earlier, we may push some stuff back, and we'll certainly be adding and tweaking stuff based on YOUR feedback. But after a year of demos and playtests and working with our community, we're confident these next two HUGE updates will be exciting and meaningful.

Our early access launch is really just the start of our journey, so we'd love for you to join us tomorrow and be a part of it.

[h2]What languages will Critter Cove launch with?[/h2]

Tomorrow we'll be launching the game in English, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, French and Russian. We're still working on a German and Spanish translation, which we'll be adding during Early Access. To avoid confusion, we've removed German and Spanish from our Steam page a few weeks back, but just a further notice that it may be a little while before those go in!

[h2]Carrying saves from the demo[/h2]

Tomorrow you should be able to simply load the main game and play straight from your demo save without having to mess with any files. Due to how Steam works, this is something that is tricky to test before launch. If there are any problems that come up during launch, or any additional steps required, we'll post about them here, on Discord, and on the forums.

Once you've saved in the full game though, don't try to load that save in the demo! This could lead to your save corrupting. We recommend that you uninstall the demo after you've installed the main game and never look back.

[h2]Our future save plans[/h2]

Our plan is to develop the game in a way where you won't have to restart the game at any point and can still pick up your save during each update. We cannot absolutely guarantee this of course, but we've successfully managed to make our demo compatible with the main game despite the main game having a huge amount of updates, so we're hoping we can continue that process throughout all of Early Access.

[h2]How to contact us[/h2]

The best place to hang out for support and help with the game will be our [url=https://discord.com/invite/QtUafGf]Discord[/url], but we'll also be keeping an eye on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1631470/discussions/]Steam forums[/url] if you need help.

notes.title: Critter Cove is Coming To Early Access September 10th
notes.content:
Critter Cove is launching in a weeks time!

The game has absolutely been a labor of love.  We have tried to perfect everything about this archipelago and its quirky cast of characters, and we know that our loyal fans are growing ever more anxious to get out there and explore. 

But this launch certainly isn’t the end of our journey together, so don’t be jumping out this bathtub-boat quite so fast!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/7179a495ec09034b50da3e91a92d867a81ed9d2a.gif[/img]

Through numerous playtests and our demo, we have already received and incorporated so much invaluable feedback. Major features like friendship bracelets, which help you locate villagers, and accessibility options such as motion sickness tools wouldn’t be in the game without direct feedback from you guys!

[h2]How we’re approaching Early Access[/h2]

For us, Early Access is the best of both worlds. Players get the chance to explore the world and give us feedback as they play. We’re already used to working with our community and we’ve launched a CHUNKY demo to explore -- go and play that if you haven’t yet, because saves will carry over to the full game!

During Early Access, we'll continue fine-tuning the experience while also bringing you brand new world areas, new characters and quests during the Early Access period. We've got a full road map that we're working towards and we'll be sharing that here just before launch! 

On launch day you'll find new islands, outposts and underwater points of interest (including the much anticipated Sunken City) to explore, which will expand the game’s playable area several times over.

You'll also get the chance to truly upgrade your town, develop your farming expertise (both on land and underwater), explore new islands as well as the oceanic expanses in between, develop tourism into a thriving business, and discover and build hundreds of new crafting recipes. 

In the Early Access launch, the Museum, Clothing Store, Bait Shop, Tavern and the Furniture Store await your upgrades, and several kiosk-style carts have been added for you to discover, craft and stock, much to the delight of your visiting tourists. And the most exciting news for our angling fans is the addition of fishing, via the fully decked out bait shop: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/6cff5da5062e47c9cb0c04759fb66eb82b9a50e6.png[/img]

On the customization front, character creation has even more options, and there is now a way to change your character’s appearance if you decide you really DID want those dragon wings after all. There are new recipes, new plants and seeds, new critters to meet and new critter housing options. You can even get a wetsuit and fins to assist you in your deeper cold water diving expeditions!

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

Before launch, we’ll be revealing our roadmap for Early Access which will include some details with regard to the next two big updates and how we’re going to expand the world even further, of course in terms of new islands, but also new biomes and new features that will unlock as you grow the town.

But like any good Early Access game, such plans are designed to be developed with our players in mind, so we encourage everyone to jump on [url=https://discord.com/invite/QtUafGf]Discord[/url] with us and join us on this adventure. See you on the island!

notes.title: Demo Version 4: Japanese and Brazilian Portuguese Added!
notes.content:
Ahoy Critters!

We've made some small bug fixes to the demo and added some new languages!

[h2]New Languages: Japanese and Brazilian Portuguese[/h2] 

This in addition to the Chinese and Russian support already in the demo. We've done our best to test the new languages, but keep in mind this is still a demo and things might not be perfect! We'd love to hear your feedback / any bugs relating to other languages, either in the comments here or over on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1631470/discussions]the forums[/url]!

[h2]Cloud Sync[/h2]

Processing save files to prepare them for steam cloud sync. We will be turning on sync shortly. Sync will share and synchronize your saves between devices (laptop/desktop/steam deck).  If you manually copied save files between devices you may end up with duplicate saves.  Just delete the extra ones as needed. Open the game and then quit to allow the sync process to work fully.

It is recommend to allow steam to upload the data before going to another device to sync.

For Steam Deck it is recommend to quit fully out and reopen if you are in a suspend state. Reopen, then let the files get processed and then quit again to fully allow synchronization to work. 

This is a one time process and will not be needed moving forward.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

Fixed a cooking bug where extra raw resources where being consumed when cooking multiple items.

- The Critter Cove Team

notes.title: Dev Log #8: The Final Playtest
notes.content:
[h2]Atualização[/h2] 

Olá, Critters!

Decidimos adiar o início do teste por uma semana, até 4 de abril, para garantir uma experiência mais fluida e divertida para todos os nossos aventureiros. 

Pedimos desculpas pelo atraso, mas não se preocupem! Esse tempo a mais vai nos possibilitar fazer pequenos ajustes ao jogo e assegurar que ele está nos trinques para que vocês se divirtam. O teste ainda vai durar por todo o mês de abril, então haverá bastante tempo para se juntar a nós na ilha!

--

[h2]Update[/h2] 

Ahoy, Critters!

We've made the decision to delay the playtest for one week, until April 4th, to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable experience for all our adventurers. 

We apologize for the delay, but fear not! This extra time will allow us to fine-tune the game and ensure it's ship-shape for your enjoyment. We'll still be running the test throughout all of April, so there will be plenty of time to join us on the island!

--

Ahoy Critters!

It’s nearly time to set sail for our second – and final – closed playtest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/7205cbe612195bf1faef519557901cb7493af7db.gif[/img]

[h2]Playtest Timing[/h2]

You’ll be able to play starting March 28th, and the playtest will be available on Steam until the end of April, so plenty of time to check out the game.

This is a closed test, but if you sign up before March 28th, you’ll be guaranteed entry! To sign up, you need to hit the “Request Access” button on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631470/Critter_Cove/]main Steam page[/url].

[h2]What’s New in Playtest Two?[/h2]

This playtest covers the first few hours of the game:  the very start (including character creation), a little section of the open-world, and some introductions to many of the game's features like farming, crafting, exploration and tourism!

We’ve added the tourism mechanic and introduction, and this time the game will be fully playable on a controller AND in Simplified Chinese. We’ve also made some significant performance increases and Steamdeck-friendly updates!

The second playtest takes place in the same part of the game as our playtest from last year. It’s actually a little shorter and tighter than the original as we refine those opening hours, but we’d still love for you to play and tell us what you think about all the changes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/63966778c9dfc7c547dd88ff34089b200ff0bddc.gif[/img]
Don't forget this a playtest build of the game -- there might be a few bugs!

[h2]Win $50 and a Copy of Critter Cove in the Feedback Prize Draw[/h2]

We’re doing a little prize draw for people willing to tell us what they think about the playtest! We’ll be giving away $50 in Steam Credit and a copy of Critter Cove to five lucky winners.

To be entered, you’ll need to fill in our feedback form during the playtest, and join our Discord. We’ll provide more information when we launch the playtest on March 28th.

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

Our demo is the next step towards launch! It’ll be a slightly more polished version of the playtest and will be available on Steam for everyone to play.

This will be arriving at some point before we take part in the Steam Next Fest in June. After that, it will finally be time to release the game into Early Access. We’re currently planning to launch in July, but our official release date will be announced in early June with a brand new trailer!

The Critter Cove Team

notes.title: Critter Cove Dev Log #6 - New Year, New Playtest!
notes.content:
Hey Critters... and Happy 2024!

This year is the big one! We’ll be launching Critter Cove into Early Access after many years of hard work! Look how far we’ve come:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/14150cd47ad861a3829e3cd0bff662bab948db5f.png[/img]

It’s been a wild ride, and we’ve made huge progress since the playtest last year in adding new features, fixing bugs and expanding the world. We’ve also been working on everything from the way swimming feels to how farming works, and can’t wait to show you guys for free soon (more on that below).

We’re busy working on a full Chinese translation of the game too, and we’re happy to announce that both the public demo and the early access build will be fully playable in simplified Chinese. Currently it’s unlikely the playtest will be translated in time, but if that changes, we’ll make sure it’s clear on the store page!

We’ve also returned to self-publishing this year after parting ways very amicably with our previous publisher.  We’re still the same core team and more active than ever, plus we have some new dates to share with you all.  

[h2]New Release Date, Playtest & Demo[/h2]

Returning to self-publishing is exciting and allows us more freedom to grow in terms of our vision for Critter Cove, but it also means we’ve had to take back over the tasks that were previously handled by the publisher.  We’ve moved around some resources and adjusted timelines over the last few months; so while we had planned to launch by early March, we’re now moving the release date of Critter Cove back a few months from “Q1” to “Q2” -- which is fancy marketing talk for “sometime around the middle of the year.” 

We want to launch a big, chunky adventure with a huge amount of content from our very first day in Early Access, and we need a little bit of extra time to get there after this brief distraction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/bf8343b273d66f76da7190c91dfc02adc6f5320f.png[/img]

If that seems like a long time to wait, we’re happy to announce TWO free ways to check out the game before we launch: A public demo and a closed beta playtest.

We’ll be making the public demo available a few months before we launch, but if you want to play even earlier, you can apply to join the beta playtest. If you signed up for last year's playtest, we’ve automatically approved you for this one as a thank you for taking part, so you don’t need to do anything at all.

If you didn’t play last year, you can register your interest via the sign up button on the store page. Keep an eye on Discord and X for more information as well, and we hope to have the beta in your paws by early March!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/09c4a29d9bfaa2044cb8d15a97135e6dc9d6f330.png[/img]

While both the demo and playtest will contain the opening part of the game that was included from last year, we’ll have a whole new range of features including our tourism update and farming improvements available right at the start. That’s alongside hundreds of tweaks, bug fixes, performance improvements, full controller support and many changes based on your feedback from the last test -- so it’s absolutely worth joining us in our post-apocalyptic paradise once again.

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

As we get ready for the playtest, we’ll be taking some “deep dives” (get it?) into the world of Critter Cove right here on Steam, starting with a look at how farming and cooking work in the game later this month.

We also post videos and updates regularly on X/Twitter, but as always the best place to hang out is our [url=https://discord.com/invite/QtUafGf]Discord[/url], where we are happy to answer any questions and take feedback! See you there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/1e87b1cf3abb66044714d8f2c50bdd28170c74b7.png[/img]

[b]- The Critter Cove Team[/b]

notes.title: Critter Cove Devlog #5 - Introducing Tourism
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone,

It’s the Critter Cove dev team, Gentlemen Rat here - we’ve managed to distract Pokee, Sammi and Anchor long enough to write our own dev log!

We’ve also got a new exciting feature to talk about: tourism, but more on that below, along with a competition to win a copy of the game![/h3]


[b][h2]Lessons from the playtest[/h2][/b]

[h3]We’ve had a lot of fun watching the hundreds of videos and streams our community has made. It’s gratifying to see so many people playing the game for the first time, so we’d like to thank you very much for participating![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/6e3997977b97019947bf4dd81e1b3ac8ec9f5cb1.png[/img]
[i]CakeJumper getting a piece of Pokee's mind[/i]

[h3]The playtest has been incredible in helping us learn what people love - and didn’t love - about the game. There are a few things we’ve picked up from talking to players, reading posts here and on Discord and also just watching how people play that are going to shape the game moving forward.

We noticed a lot of things that people loved about the game, from spending an hour in the character creator making the perfect avatar to exploring the underwater depths and our open world, which we feel is a huge asset and unique part of the game. We’ve also looked at places where we think we can make lots of improvements.

[b]Greater Motivation:[/b] The playtest didn’t have our opening “shipwreck” cutscene, but even if we did, we’re not sure we’ve given players enough understanding of why they are hanging out in Critter Cove. 

The early game experience is a lot of characters randomly giving you a bunch of requests to clean up the town or fix buildings giving you a house, and suddenly an hour later you’re building this whole workshop.  Sure, you might just want to gather the resources to stop Sammi from living in a tent his whole life but a bigger picture reason for why you’re here is missing from the early game.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/48d9a24c838de4707c56bc8388a97b9510006ee1.png[/img]
[i]Please, somebody get this cat a house![/i]

[h3]We’ve noticed players having a lack of a clear long-term goal leads to the game feeling either too open (in terms of the world itself) or too prescribed (simply following a checklist of quests exactly without any organic exploration). This has been a particular challenge for a limited playtest as the game does open up in mid-game.

[b]A clearer “core loop”:[/b] There’s a single main thing that you do that everything else feeds into. This is usually called the “core loop”. In a lot of games that we’ve taken inspiration from, this core loop often involves farming.

There’s a lot to do in Critter Cove, like exploring, fishing, farming or crafting, but in the playtest everything can feel very separate. In the mid-game, the climb to new town ranks is the closest we come to the main objective of the game, but this doesn’t become clear until a few hours in. Even when it is clear, most of the town rank objectives are about finding a certain unique item or resource in the world, so they tie into exploration heavily but other systems - like personalisation - don’t touch them at all.

[b]Tone[/b] - We’ve been enjoying watching people interact with the townsfolk, and we’ve noted that people especially love our more onerous and irritable initial resident Pokee and the way she interacts with players. We certainly don’t want every character to act like Pokee - even Pokee herself wouldn’t want that - but we do want to show more of the weird and distinctive characters and situations that can happen with the critters as early and often as we can![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238006/ec7822ebac134e562b16bf6f776caf87ceab4aff.png[/img]
[i]What an attitude![/i]

[h3]Today, we want to talk about our tourism system, and how we’re going to make it an earlier and larger part of the Critter Cove experience, as well as making a big step to solve some of these issues![/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kvG2D3V.gif[/img]

[b][h2]Introducing… Tourism and Tourism Rating[/h2][/b]

[h3]Rather than simply washing up on the docks and starting to fix up old buildings, your job will be to help the town and its citizens become a bustling tourist destination! Every few days, tourists will visit your town on a cruise ship, and it’s your job to keep them entertained, happy and spending doubloons.

Tourism was always going to be a feature, although it was to come in after players repaired the Lighthouse, many hours into the game. Bringing it forward has a lot of advantages though - you get a real reason for being on the island right away, and you get to see a lot more of the Critters and their weird and wonderful interactions with the world much sooner. Most importantly, you get a real sense that every activity you do in the game now makes sense in your larger goal of bringing Critter Cove back to life, while putting some doubloons in your pocket.

You can do this by expanding the stores, food and entertainment options in your town, and raising your tourism rating. The higher your rating, the more new buildings you’ll be able to repair and reopen, bringing even more tourists to spend even more doubloons! Unlike the old town rank system, you’ll be able to unlock buildings in the order you choose which means you can create a completely unique town.

Tourists will be able to shop in the stores you open, eat at the cafe - even visit the museum. So you’ll want to make sure you’ve got the right Critters working in the right businesses (word to the wise: don’t let Pokee make the coffee). They’re also likely to get into mischief, hit by lightning, accidentally set themselves on fire or bury themselves in the sand. Just like regular tourists!

Of course, Critter Cove has a wide-open archipelago to explore, so you won’t just be spending all your time in town. In fact, with tourism as the focus, there’s even more reason to sail to distant shores and find special items, resources and Critters you’ll need to turn your town into the best possible destination.


We’re hard at work bringing forward these mechanics into the early game, and are looking forward to sharing more in the coming weeks. Stay tuned for more info, and check out our Discord, Twitter, and TikTok for more early looks at tourism and other  features in Critter Cove!

[i]The Critter Cove Team[/i][/h3]


[b][h2]Psst… win a copy of the game![/h2][/b]

[h3]Join the [b]“Make your own Critter” contest on X/Twitter and shape our island’s next resident![/b]

If you’re ready to make your mark in the vibrant world of Critter Cove, unleash your creative genius by crafting your very own character in our contest. This is your chance to design a unique Critter to join our cast! From animal townsfolk to quirky robots, your imagination and the character creator options are the only limits.

If we pick your design as the island’s next resident, you’ll win a Critter Cove Early Access Steam key!

Head over to [b][url=https://twitter.com/CritterCoveGame/status/1716554838501429301]this post[/url][/b] for the full overview of entry rules and remember that the entry deadline is November 3rd - good luck![/h3]
